rules: The consuming module receives no raw tag storage, hash key or database client.
Registration and revocation remain Core-managed operations.
Core's user-management UI owns enrollment; a reader adapter only supplies the transient tag code.
A module depending on core.nfc must declare at least one metadata.nfcAccessProfiles entry.
The module binding and declared NFC access profiles come from the installed manifest.
A plain NFC UID or member barcode never replaces a password or 2FA and never creates a session.
Scanner hardware, attendance, booking and other domain workflows stay outside Core.
